description:
A Stripe payment link for a pack of credits, for when the user wants to buy.

    Nothing is charged by this call: the user pays on Stripe's page, and the credits
    arrive when that payment completes. `pack` is the number of credits in one of the
    packs get_credit_balance lists; 0 means the smallest. Purchased credits never
    expire.
name: buy_credits
title: Buy credits
